title: Subscription-Only Auto Run CEO — AUDIT_R1 corrections F1-F4: canonical autonomous provenance w/ credential-scrubbed CODEX child env, cap-agnostic metered denial, atomic CODEX SUBSCRIPTION+AUTH_OK re-proof, CEO auth independent of executor supply
description: AUDIT_R1 corrections F1-F4 on the opt-in subscription-only autonomous lane (PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1, still default OFF). F1: codex-adapter derives autonomous provenance canonically — dispatch resolves task→mission→work_open_binding.created_by=DRIVER_ACTOR via the evidence store (caller metadata not trusted); OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY reach the CLI child only for manual lineage, autonomous children get a whitelisted env (PATH/HOME/CODEX_HOME/Windows essentials); store dep wired in serve-mission-control.mjs. F2: metered autonomy is unconditional — dispatchCostEnvelope + the assertAndReserve autonomous gate deny driver-attributed METERED_API/UNKNOWN/unbounded/unprovable pairings under ANY cap (absent/zero/positive) → DRIVER_METERED_FORBIDDEN / FAIL_CLOSED_COST_AUTONOMOUS_METERED; manual lineage and positive-cap metered semantics unchanged. F3: driver-attributed CODEX dispatch re-proves ACTIVE SUBSCRIPTION profile + codex-cli AUTH_OK provider session inside the same atomic txn → FAIL_CLOSED_COST_AUTONOMOUS_SUBSCRIPTION; FREE/UNMETERED/missing profile never substitute; COMMITTED/SETTLED adoption preserved. F4: readiness/admission re-proves CEO codex-cli AUTH_OK independently of executor supply — PAIR_NATIVE-only supply no longer implies CEO can run → DRIVER_SUBSCRIPTION_UNVERIFIED; scheduler FAULT_LABELS extended for the new denials. Evidence: 42 focused regressions (Z8.1-12 env-strip/cap-agnostic deny/sub+auth re-proof/CEO-independence/adopt-after-drift; strengthened Z7 drives the real CodexCliExecutorAdapter through MissionRuntime ticks → observe→collect→settle terminal, $0 COMMITTED reservation, child env asserted). Harnesses: p15-10c family + phase-c-r1 seed canonical executor/provider/SUBSCRIPTION rows, cap-arithmetic tests moved to manual lineage; win32 baselines unchanged (10d=15, met-fold=7, p15-3=9, cpl1=22, p5=3).
